name: Mincemeat Pinwheels
author: The Wickham family
steps: Add egg yolk, beat until combined.
Add sifted flour, spice, soda and milk.
Press together to form a soft dough.
Turn onto lightly floured surface and knead for 2 minutes until smooth.
Leave, covered with plastic wrap, in refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Roll out onto lightly floured surface to a rectangle 20 x 28 cm.
Roll up from the long side.
Using a sharp knife cut log into 8 mm-thick rounds.
Place on prepared trays and bake for 10 minutes at 180C.
Comments: An alternative to mince pies
